reviews.text: We worked with Sarah when she was in Ontario! she has trained us to understand how to provide an excellent quality of life to our American Bully XL. This breed is not for the weak, and with the right training, Sarah was able to teach us how to better ourselves so that our dog can thrive! Over a year later, we continue to implement Sarah’s training and techniques in our day to day lives with our boy. We highly recommend all that Sarah and her team has to offer!

We absolutely love Pawsitive Vibes K9 for boarding and training! Brooke is patient, reliable, and truly cares about every dog she works with. We’ve been with Pawsitive Vibes K9 for a little over 3 years and our dogs have grown so much in confidence and obedience. We always feel at ease leaving them with Brooke because we know they’re safe, loved, and in the best hands.
Great service, she’s awesome

Hands-down the BEST. Best trainer, daycare, boarding, the whole package -  Brooke is more knowledgeable on everything canine than anyone I know, no exaggeration.
Within a week after getting my three month old rescue pup, I started with Pawsitive Vibes. They have taught her as well as me over the past eight months and I couldn’t be more grateful. I have also counted on them for daycare, pack walks and boarding.
One of the best measures is how excited and happy my dog Heifer is whenever the white van pulls up or a trainer arrives for a one on one session.
Prices are very reasonable and they’re willing always to go the extra mile.
Grey Service. Would definitely use them again!

Brooke and Sarah are incredible! My husband and I have a young rescue pit who can be nervous around new people and places. When we had to board him over the holidays we searched high and low to find a place for our pup to feel comfortable. And thank goodness we found Pawsitive Vibes k9! Brooke and Sarah are the kind of leaders and trainers that will make sure our Griffey is fulfilled when he stays with them. He is always excited to see them, which puts all my own nerves at ease. I really appreciate that Brooke and Sarah take their time to focus on building a relationship and trust with our dog, making sure he is able to build his own self confidence along the way. I can’t recommend Brooke and Sarah enough, and I’m so grateful to them for taking incredible care of our boy.

I got a puppy and was so happy to find Brooke and Sarah at Pawsitive Vibes K9! They helped me so much with obedient training, indoor and outdoor, socializing and pet sitting. Highly recommend for all of your dogs needs!

Brooke and Sarah go above and beyond.  We have 3 frenchies and a Shepard mix who all have different and specific needs.  We never need to worry about them while spending the day in their care.  Which as any frenchie owner will tell you, is a real stress.  They have learned recall and calm down techniques.  The dogs are socialized with all other breeds, great on leash now and come home tired out and happy.  We get adorable photo and video updates daily.  I strongly recommend them for training and boarding!

I had such an amazing experience with Brooke & Sara. I hired them to work with one of my dogs, but during our in-home visit they also worked with my other dog. I boarded my dog with them for two weeks and his behavior was much improved. The most important part was that they taught me how to continue with the training. I highly recommend them.

I can’t say enough good things about the Pawsitive Vibes team. They helped ensure the right behaviors from my dog from the early puppy stages, and also set me up for success by teaching me how to be a good owner and the importance of relationship building with my dog. Even after training, they are still always willing to help answer questions etc.
thanks for loving my pup so much!

We've worked with both Sarah and Brooke, and can't say enough good things about them. They're awesome to work with, and great with our furry family member. We have a hyper frenchie (surprise surprise) who just loves to great people at the door and jumps with excitement!! The Pawsitive Vibes team helped us to work with our dog to control his excitement, and in just one training session we're already seeing amazing results. We're looking forward to working with them again.

I can't say enough good things about Brooke and Sarah. They have known Cade, my Dutchie x Malinois since he was a puppy and he adores them. They have been so incredible, just a wealth of support, knowledge, and assistance throughout his puppyhood and into his teenage years. Sarah helped me with his impulse control (of which he has barely any around her because he loves her so much 🤣) and helped teach me how to play tug. Their packwalks are a godsend to help build his confidence and impulse control through fun activities and structure.
